messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deployment finished for v3.5.0 — canary at 12% (us-west).
alex: Observing early regressions: gen error-rate +3.6% on small sample. gen-ql-8bit p95 ~420ms (was ~180ms).
maria: Seeing KV cache churn and extra encoder passes. Pattern is intermittent; doesn't meet auto-rollback thresholds.
lee: Auto-rollback requires >5% error OR sustained p95 >300ms for 10m. We have a spike but noisy—manual call.
sam: Given customer exposure and latency spike, propose manual rollback and pin to v3.4.2. Need customer comms for Dedicated accounts.
tariq: Proposed exec steps:
1) pin traffic to v3.4.2
2) stop canary expansion
3) manual rollback in us-west
4) notify support + incident tag
release-coordinator: I will draft the external note. Keep timeline short, include ETA for hotfix.
alex: Runbook command (deploy shell):
```
/deploy rollback --to=v3.4.2 --scope=canary --region=us-west --reason="canary-latency-regression"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback command received, validating perms...
deploy-bot: Validation OK. Initiating rollback (us-west) at 1799900000.
maria: Draining new canary nodes, reattach traffic to pinned pool, flushing KV caches on affected hosts.
ops-bot: Notice: 8 nodes recycling. Small transient latency bump expected during drain, watch p95.
lee: Monitoring: p95 dropping toward baseline after first host flip (~190ms). Error-rate trending back down.
sam: Sending comms to enterprise contacts and posting in #releases. ETA for hotfix triage: 3h.
release-coordinator: Posted to #customers-enterprise and alerted account SEs. Incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incident/17999
alex: Action items: eng-runtime to investigate KV cache/quantization interaction (maria), eng-ml to expand evals, release to hold v3.5.0 until v3.5.1 validated.
maria: Kicked off repro against canary traffic profile; will update in 30m.
tariq: Adding rollback tag to deploy record and pinning auto-update customers where applicable.
lee: No new alerts; will close rollback exec thread once hotfix plan is in place. :thumbsup:
sam: Keep updates short and customer-facing text clear here.
alex: Will add short amendment to release notes explaining pause and next steps.
ops-bot: Roll action complete: v3.4.2 now serving canary traffic in us-west (rollback by alex).
maria: Follow-up: initial repro indicates a race during quantized checkpoint load causing KV invalidation. Patching now.
tariq: Marking incident P2; scheduling postmortem and adding links to incident page.
release-coordinator: Closing this thread for the immediate rollback. Reopen if any regressions persist. :eyes:
